title: Server-Side Validation
summary: The standard OnServerEvent body: type-check every argument, range-check every number, ownership-check every object, state-check every precondition — BEFORE acting. Reject silently or log; never trust.

explanation.whatItIs: A checklist discipline for every remote handler: nothing passes without proving itself.
explanation.whyItExists: Clients are hostile territory (see never-trust-the-client). Validation is the server's immune system.
whenToUse: Layers: typeof → allowed-values → ownership → game state → cooldown
Log failures during development to catch broken clients AND exploit probes
whenNotToUse: As the only layer — pair with rate limiting and server-authoritative outcomes
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
OnServerEvent(player, …args)
  1. TYPE:     typeof(arg) == expected?
  2. VALUE:    number in sane range? string in allowlist?
  3. OWNERSHIP: does player own/qualify for the target?
  4. STATE:    is the game in a state where this is legal?
  5. TIMING:   cooldown/rate ok?
  ── only then: act, and recompute results server-side
```
tips: Small validator helpers keep handlers readable
Return without acting on failure; don't explain weaknesses to the caller
Instance arguments: verify they're where they should be (AncestryIsAncestorOf / Parent checks)
commonMistakes: Erroring the handler on bad input instead of returning (crashes your own log, not theirs)

examples.title: Full validation ladder
examples.code:
local ALLOWED = { Fireball = true, Heal = true }
local lastCast = {}
local RATE = 0.5

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, spellName, target)
    -- 1. type
    if typeof(spellName) ~= "string" then return end
    -- 2. value
    if not ALLOWED[spellName] then return end
    -- 3. ownership/range (example: target must be a living character within 100 studs)
    local character = player.Character
    if not (character and character.PrimaryPart) then return end
    if target and target.Parent then
        local dist = (character.PrimaryPart.Position - target.Position).Magnitude
        if dist > 100 then return end
    end
    -- 4. state
    if game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio() then end -- hook your game-state checks here
    -- 5. timing
    local now = os.clock()
    if lastCast[player] and now - lastCast[player] < RATE then return end
    lastCast[player] = now

    castSpell(player, spellName, target)   -- server computes the outcome
end)
